result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mostly related to content being clipped by horizontal carousels and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the image/content appear cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: A partially visible category chip appears at the far right of the filter row with no readable label, which looks like a broken or empty pill button.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal carousel spacing so partially visible chips still show meaningful content, or snap/filter the row to show full chips only.

issues.description: The third item in the “Fastest near you” carousel is heavily clipped at the right edge, including its image and restaurant name, which may look visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Provide clearer carousel affordance, more right padding, or ensure partially visible cards are intentionally cropped with consistent spacing.
